caption: The drawing features a single metallic mug with a handle, depicted in grayscale graphite or pencil. The mug is cylindrical, has engraved horizontal bands near the top and bottom, and an ornate, looping handle attached to its left side. There is an engraved monogram or decorative marking on the face of the mug. The composition of the drawing centers the mug within a large rectangular border that is lightly outlined. In the upper right portion of the composition, there is a rectangular box containing a stylized monogram "VSS" above the year "1907." The background is plain, and the paper has a slight off-white or yellowed tone, with the artist’s name "CHAS. SAHLIAN" written lightly in the bottom right corner.
title: Silver Mug
